name: Town Hall, Stairwell
desc1: The seat of the Arlysian Government resides here in the Town Hall.
desc2: However, most will tell you that the local Mayor is but a figurehead,
desc3: and that the real power in this city comes from the guilds and their
desc4: small offices, rather than this elaborate building.  Stairs lead up
desc5: to the offices and housing above.
